title: Planes in quadratic 4-space and associated shapes of lattices
summary: Let $Q=-x_1^2-x_2^2-x_3^2+x_4^2$ be the standard signature $(1,3)$ quadratic form. To each non-degenerate rational plane $L$ in the four-dimensional quadratic space $(\mathbb{Q}^4,Q)$ we can naturally attach a periodic geodesic on the Bianchi orbifold $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z}[i])\backslash \mathbb{H}^3$ which records the position of $L$ in the Grassmannian up to integer rotations.
